mapper.select: select bb.id,bb.gateway_id,bb.caller,bb.project_name,bb.outbound_number,bb.line_supplier_id,ss.line_supplier from b_marketing_line_base_info_normal bb inner join b_marketing_line_supplier_info_normal ss on bb.line_supplier_id = ss.id where bb.is_delete = 0 and ss.is_delete = 0

select bb.id,bb.gateway_id,bb.caller,bb.project_name,bb.outbound_number,bb.line_supplier_id,ss.line_supplier from b_marketing_line_base_info_normal bb inner join b_marketing_line_supplier_info_normal ss on bb.line_supplier_id = ss.id where bb.ope_status in (0, 2) and bb.is_delete = 0 and ss.ope_status = 0 and ss.is_delete = 0
mapper.update: update b_marketing_line_base_info_normal set caller=#{caller},project_name=#{projectName},outbound_number=#{outboundNumber}, ope_status = #{opeStatus},ope_time = now() where id = #{id} and ope_status in (0,2)
